now.title: WandaVision#3
now.text: Billy is the nephew of Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's twin brother who died in Sokovia.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's uncle, Wanda's twin, who died in Sokovia.

changes.evidence: A blood tie never met. Pietro dies in Sokovia in Avengers: Age of Ultron, before Billy exists. The twins are born in WandaVision#3, and the "Pietro" who arrives in WandaVision#5 and takes the boys trick-or-treating in #6 is Ralph Bohner, a Westview man Agatha enthralls to pose as Pietro (revealed in #9). The dataset already has a separate ralph-bohner record for him. Nothing on screen shows the real Pietro and Billy ever meeting or dealing with each other, and Pietro has no part in Billy's story with huge consequences.
